title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering under regional failover
author: Ava Patel
description: Context: During a regional failover incident we observed the SLO enforcer entering inconsistent backoff ordering which caused ordering inversion and unnecessary client throttling. This manifested when multiple regions reported transient packet loss and the regional failover controller triggered rapid circuit-breaker transitions. Root cause: a race between backoff priority queue updates and region-state reconciliation where deferred re-enqueues used stale priority values. Fix: 1) make backoff updates transactional by adding a lightweight in-memory version tag per request window; 2) serialize region-state reconciliation updates against backoff queue reorders using compare-and-swap on the version tag; 3) add hysteresis to the regional failover signal to avoid immediate retries-on-failover that can amplify ordering races; 4) add unit and integration tests to reproduce the race and validate ordering guarantees. This PR is a hotfix because the issue can cause customer-facing increased throttling under multi-region flaps. Checklist: - Reproduced race locally with synthetic multi-region test harness - Added deterministic integration test that fails on original behavior - Added safety checks and health metrics for backoff queue ordering - Verified with canary in staging for 2 hours with injected region flaps Changes: summary of commits and files below. Related: ENG-2847 for incident triage, ENG-2910 for long term redesign notes. Merge: squash and merge.
commits: 137451a: enforce backoff queue versioning and CAS reorder
137451b: serialize region-state reconciliation against backoff updates
137451d: add unit/integration tests reproducing ordering inversion
137451e: test flake fixes and CI config adjustments
review_comments: Miguel Santos: The transactional version tag makes sense; can you outline memory/GC implications for high QPS?
Ava Patel: We keep the tag as a 64-bit monotonic counter per enforcer instance and reuse entries; profiling in staging showed <1% memory overhead at 500k TPS.
Li Wei: I saw a potential deadlock when reconciliation waits on queue CAS; recommend a backoff with deadline instead of blocking indefinitely.
Ava Patel: Updated to use CAS with exponential backoff and a 50ms deadline per reconciliation cycle, added unit test to ensure no deadlocks.
Priya Nair: Can we expose the hysteresis window as a runtime config so SRE can tune without deploy?
Ava Patel: Exposed as runtime knob slo.enforcer.failover_hysteresis_ms with default 250ms; roadmap item logged for better auto-tuning.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer backoff ordering during regional failover. Improves reliability during multi-region flaps and reduces unnecessary throttling. Exposes runtime config slo.enforcer.failover_hysteresis_ms for tuning.
